name: Hanjuku Ren'ai
source:
Main character is an ordinary salary-man. But when he opens his apartment door one day, he hears "Welcome back, master".
Maid greets him inside and suggests entertainment with the use of various costumes and situations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
